methods.label: Reveal a common factor
methods.explanation:
Writing each difference as a single fraction reveals a common factor:
\[
x-\frac1y=\frac{xy-1}{y},\qquad y-\frac1x=\frac{xy-1}{x}.
\]
The assumptions give \(x\ne0\), \(y\ne0\), and \(xy-1=x(y-1/x)\ne0\). Thus we may divide by these quantities and cancel the common factor:
\[
\frac{x-\frac1y}{y-\frac1x}
=\frac{xy-1}{y}\cdot\frac{x}{xy-1}
=\boxed{\frac{x}{y}}.
\]
The answer is choice B.
